cases.message: a logic may not publish: move `publish "things.happened"` into the automation that calls announce, or declare announce as an automation
a logic calls queries, mutations, builtins and other logic: `automation sweep(...)` belongs in an automation
a logic ends with `return <value>`: its last statement, outside any block, is the return
`x` reads `y`, which is bound on line 3, after it: move line 3 above line 2
a logic has no trigger of its own: declare `event` in its args and read args.event, which its caller passes
